items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: That's how John Kirby got his style. I was at the Famous Door next door and at that time John Kirby had five pieces... He would come over and listen to us

ctx.x: You played the Onyx Club too?
Yeah. That's how John Kirby got his style. I was at the Famous Door next door and at that time John Kirby had five pieces and five of the loudest guys you ever heard in your life.
He had Pete Brown on saxophone-- And Frankie Newton.
